peak_context.qualification: Temporal co-occurrence, not proven cause; contact force samples are not integrated impulses

left.qualification: Privileged diagnostic; low rotation of an unloaded caster is not a slip/failure criterion.

right.qualification: Privileged diagnostic; low rotation of an unloaded caster is not a slip/failure criterion.

reset.qualification: Pre-epoch diagnostic window can straddle teleport/settling; never use it to certify a continuous post-reset standstill. Online release barrier not implemented.

windows.qualification: Contact end=max(clearance,last manifold end upper bound+0.2s); keep fixed 3s outcome too, so a longer adaptive window cannot dilute RMS unnoticed.

vertical.definition: Unfiltered samples at original IMU timestamps; sample RMS/percentile, no fabricated high-frequency peak or impulse.

audit.qualification: Saved-trace sequence audit; temporal order is not a proven root cause
audit.caster_rolling_qualification: Nominal radius .016m; body speed>.25m/s, abs yaw rate<.05rad/s, swivel alignment<.15rad, nearest GT within .05s. Positive-force subset additionally needs recorded abs vertical contact force>=1N within .015s. Low unconditional ratio can include unloaded wheels; do not label it slip/stall without support evidence. Diagnostic filters, not hardware limits or inferred readiness thresholds.
audit.damping_drag_qualification: b*omega/r at nominal caster radius0.016m and pure rolling; not a measured contact force
audit.message_gap_qualification: Only nonempty contacts are published; a gap is not proof of no contact or exact lift-off

post_arrival_stop.qualification: 2s stopped-command diagnostic, independent of arrival scoring; 5deg/.01m_s are declared diagnostic thresholds

validation.qualification: Epoch/identity only; does not replace native timestamps, gap/coverage tests or prove DDS loss-free delivery

acquisition_integrity.qualification: Explicit two-process contract only. CRC/closure are not sampling coverage. Original native replay, timestamp, per-window coverage and stopping gates remain mandatory.
